receiver_split_policy: deterministic receiver-order split: first N receivers are source, remaining receivers are target; paper does not publish exact split seeds
seed_policy: single recorded seed per row; paper does not publish repeats
input_representation: equalized time-domain WiFi preamble, power-normalized, CFO preserved, first 256 IQ samples as [256,2]
stage1: DANN global domain adaptation with source TX CE and source/target domain BCE through GRL
stage2: LMMD relevant subdomain adaptation using source labels and target predicted probabilities

formal_training_defaults.paper_status: optimizer, batch size, epochs, split seed, and train/eval target split are implementation choices because the paper does not publish them
